$comment: Transcribed by hand from the Agent Skills Discovery RFC v0.2.0, sections 'Discovery Index' and 'Integrity and Verification' (github.com/cloudflare/agent-skills-discovery-rfc at commit 1bd11679, read 2026-08-04). Transcribed rather than vendored because no machine-readable schema is published: the RFC states the $schema URI is an opaque identifier that need not resolve, and as of 2026-08-04 schemas.agentskills.io does not resolve at all. The field tables in the RFC are the normative source; this file is their JSON Schema spelling, and scripts/validate-agent-skills-index.mjs is the only consumer.

$schema.$comment: 'The index MUST include a top-level $schema field containing a URI that identifies the index schema version.' Pinned to the one version this site implements: an index claiming a version whose rules were never read here is worse than no index.

name.$comment: Agent Skills naming rules: 1-64 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens. The pattern expresses all three hyphen rules; maxLength carries the bound.

type.$comment: 'MUST be "skill-md" (single SKILL.md file) or "archive" (bundled archive).' Both are listed even though this site publishes only skill-md, so the schema stays a description of the spec rather than of today's content; the validator checks separately that an archive entry is not silently unhandled.

url.$comment: Resolved per RFC 3986 section 5 against the index URL. Path-absolute, absolute, and relative are all permitted by the spec; the validator narrows this site to path-absolute.

digest.$comment: 'formatted as sha256:{hex} where {hex} is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.'
